name: 19144 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19144 (Philadelphia) has 301 nonprofit organizations. 139 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19144 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19144 (Philadelphia) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
